text:
incident-bot: SEV-2: Metering: token-emitter heartbeat mismatch detected for ingestion-shard-7. Rate of emits dropped -> delayed usage window 00:00-00:30 UTC. Overrage flags seen in snap-agg. Pager: @oncall

alice (oncall): on it — hopping in. any customer-facing alerts so far?

ben-sre: seeing gap in emitter-heartbeat logs: `last_seen 2026-03-17T00:02:14Z` for shard-7, other shards normal. queue length spiked ~30s ago.

carmen-billing: our nightly reconciliation already flagged +8% token delta for 00:00-00:30. Some customers got overage flags from the alerting rule. We should pause flags until we confirm.

dan-cs: got 2 customers pinged support about overage notifications. Holding responses until we have more detail.

eric-eng: quick triage: looks like emitter process restarted in the shard due to garbage-collection stall. KV offset rollback caused duplicate suppression to miss -> delayed emits buffered.

francesca-pm: potential customer impact. any ETA on mitigation?

alice (oncall): mitigation plan: (1) pause overage flagging (carmen) (2) kick a controlled re-emit for shard-7 with dedupe window (eric) (3) short-term crediting/notification plan (dan/carmen).

carmen-billing: pausing flagging now. toggled `billing.alerts.overage.enabled=false` for 30m.

eric-eng: prepping re-emit. running safe-replay with dedupe TTL 2m. command I will run:
```
./tools/safe_replay --shard=7 --since="2026-03-17T00:00:00Z" --dedupe-ttl=120
```
should take ~6m.

ben-sre: while replay runs, I'm going to scale emitter consumers and drain queue to avoid re-overload: `kubectl scale deploy/emitter-shard-7 --replicas=4` then monitor queue length.

alice (oncall): noted. set status page to "investigating (metering)" and add a note about delayed usage windows. I'll handle the page update.

dan-cs: prepping a short customer message: "We observed delayed reporting for some usage windows. We have paused automated overage notifications and are replaying buffered events. We'll post follow-up with any billing adjustments."

carmen-billing: if replay restores counts, we'll issue credits for false overage flags. estimating scope: ~120 affected accounts (likely low-traffic). I'll start a manual credit batch if counts reconcile.

eric-eng: replay finished. logs:
```
INFO replay: 2026-03-17T00:08:20Z replayed 12,345 events for shard-7
INFO dedupe: 98% dedup hit
```
queue length back to normal. token counts for windows rehydrated.

ben-sre: scaled down replicas to 2 after stabilization. metrics look green. no error spikes.

alice (oncall): confirm probing: billing delta now within expected variance. Carmen, can you validate reconciliation output?

carmen-billing: validated. delta reduced to <0.5%. Overages flagged -> cleared. preparing credit notes for the 9 customers who had UI flags before we paused.

dan-cs: informing the 2 customers who opened tickets now. we'll use the templated message and note the manual credit.

francesca-pm: good ops here — can we add a postmortem checklist? auto-pause hook for overage alerts on emitter lag + a playbook for safe_replay.

eric-eng: agree. I'll open a PR with playbook + add an alert that auto-suppresses overage-notifications when emitter-heartbeat gap > 60s.

alice (oncall): closing handoff. root cause: GC-induced emitter restart -> buffered emits + short dedupe window gap -> delayed reporting + transient overage flags. Remediation: replay + pause alerts + credits issued.

incident-bot: Incident closed by alice (oncall) at 2026-03-17T00:35:43Z. Postmortem required within 48h. :white_check_mark:
